PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: atmosphere-divine-light-rays-god-rays-effect-variation-1
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain; explicitly requested golden luminous-VFX behavior only.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
DIVINE LIGHT RAYS - GOD RAYS EFFECT — VARIATION 1: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic volumetric divine god rays effect for the biblical epic JESUS: THE HARROWING OF HELL, capturing the sacred intrusion of heavenly light into the underworld at the moment divine radiance first pierces Hell’s vertical approach shaft and later floods the fortress after the gate shatters. Pure production-reference atmosphere plate: the subject is light itself—dense, directional, living columns of illumination—not a character portrait.

Primary visual subject: thick volumetric god rays of ethereal gold and warm amber streaming downward from an unseen source high above, color temperatures reading as pure white core at approximately 6500K that softens outward into radiant gold (#FFD700) and amber (#FFBF00) edges. The beams travel through a tall vertical shaft cut through black earth and obsidian stone, roughly forty feet across at the upper rim, walls veined with dying ember-red cracks that glow faintly against the descending gold. The light does not behave like ordinary sunlight; it feels older, denser, and purposeful—pushing back darkness as if the shadows themselves retreat like living things.

Particle and atmosphere construction: fine dust, ash, and ancient mineral grit hang suspended in still, heavy air; each particle becomes a bright fleck where the rays pass, rendering every shaft of light as a visible solid column with soft penumbral edges. Thin layers of smoke and cold vapor drift laterally through the beams, scattering gold into soft volumetric blooms while leaving cold blue-shadow pockets between the rays. Where light meets lingering hell atmosphere, a faint warm perfume-haze quality replaces poison grit at the beam cores—warm amber air versus the remaining cold blue torch-tone gloom at approximately 2000K still clinging to the lower periphery.

Environment context for continuity: deep crimsons and obsidian blacks frame the composition at the edges (#8B0000, #0A0A0A); residual cold royal-blue torch spill (#4169E1) and red underglow (~3500K) survive only in unlit recesses and lower corners, creating sharp chromatic contrast against the advancing divine palette. Far below or at the base of the frame, suggestion of fortress architecture—black stone pillars, a smoke ceiling, the distant bulk of iron-and-bone gate or shattered threshold—remains half-silhouetted so the rays dominate. No readable carvings, no modern fixtures, no electrical light sources.

Light behavior and physics: primary key is overhead directional divine radiance; beams are nearly parallel with subtle natural taper as they descend, some broken by shaft-lip geometry into layered blades of light. Secondary fill is soft golden bounce off illuminated particulate; rim light is pure white-gold where beam edges cut through thicker smoke. Shadow side remains cool, deep, and bluish—never pure black void—so the volumetric contrast reads photographically. Occasional stronger spears of light suggest the later gate-shatter flood, when blinding golden power pours through a breach and burns residual darkness from every corner.

Camera and framing: ultra-wide to medium-wide production plate suitable for VFX reference and plate compositing, approximately 24mm–35mm equivalent, slight low or slightly elevated three-quarter shaft view emphasizing vertical travel of light from upper frame to infinite depth. Aspect ratio 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen. Deep depth of field so ray structure, particulate layers, and architectural silhouettes remain readable; mild anamorphic-style atmospheric haze, no lens flares that look digital or branded, no modern camera brand cues. Composition keeps the strongest ray bundle as the visual hero, with secondary shafts creating depth corridors through smoke.

Texture and material truth: stone is rough obsidian and basalt with matte mineral dust; ash is fine grey-white and charcoal; smoke is translucent and layered, not solid fog walls; light is photoreal volumetric scattering, not illustrated beams or fantasy magic streaks. No CGI cartoon look, no illustration style, no neon, no laser aesthetics.

Color grade lock: ethereal golds and warm ambers as hero keys; cold blue residual hell shadows and bruised crimson periphery for before-full-transformation beats; pure white divine core in the brightest ray centers. Continuity locks: god rays always divine gold-white, never hell-fire red; hell torches remain blue only in unlit pockets until full transformation; materials remain ancient stone, ash, smoke, iron-bone silhouette only.

Hard constraints: photoreal live-action biblical epic production reference; no modern objects, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no captions, no written or graphical elements, no UI, no text overlays; one continuous sacred atmosphere plate of divine light cutting darkness.
